verses.sloka: सचन्द्रकुमुदं रम्यं सार्ककारण्डवं शुभम् ।तिष्यश्रवणकादम्बमभ्रशैवालशाद्वलम् ।। 5.57.1 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sacandrakumudaṁ ramyaṁ sārkakāraṇḍavaṁ śubham ।tiṣyaśravaṇakādambamabhraśaivālaśādvalam ।। 5.57.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman leaped ike the Windgod, unwearied across the sky, as a huge boat crosses an ocean. The ocean was graced with a swan, the sky with constellation of Swati with fullblown lotuses and water lilies, like the nagas, yakshas, and gandharvas gathered together. The Moon in the sky was like a white lotus, the Sun like a waterfowl, the auspicious Tishya and Shravana like the sweetvoiced swans, and the clouds like duckweeds and green grassy spots on the shore. The Punarvasu star was like a large fish and the planet Mars was like a crocodile. Airavata was like the great island. The waves produced by the wind were like cool moonlight in the cold water.
translations.hindi: सुन्दरकाण्ड का साठवा सगं पूरा हुआ । —:o:-— एकषष्टितमः सगः ततो जाम्बवतो वाक्यमगहन्त वनोकसः। ्रद्गदप्रमुखा वीरा हनूमांश्च महाकपिः

verses.sloka: पुलर्वसुमहामीनं लोहिताङ्गमहाग्रहम् ।ऐरावतमहाद्वीपं स्वातीहंसविलोलितम् ।। 5.57.2 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pularvasumahāmīnaṁ lohitāṅgamahāgraham ।airāvatamahādvīpaṁ svātīhaṁsavilolitam ।। 5.57.2 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman leaped ike the Windgod, unwearied across the sky, as a huge boat crosses an ocean. The ocean was graced with a swan, the sky with constellation of Swati with fullblown lotuses and water lilies, like the nagas, yakshas, and gandharvas gathered together. The Moon in the sky was like a white lotus, the Sun like a waterfowl, the auspicious Tishya and Shravana like the sweetvoiced swans, and the clouds like duckweeds and green grassy spots on the shore. The Punarvasu star was like a large fish and the planet Mars was like a crocodile. Airavata was like the great island. The waves produced by the wind were like cool moonlight in the cold water.
translations.hindi: श्रौर पवननन्दन *हनुमानजी को भागे कर प्रसन्न होते हुए समस्त वानर महेन्द्राचल को छोड़, उछलते-कदते चल दिए

verses.sloka: वातसङ्घातजातोर्मिचन्द्रांशुशिशिराम्बुमत् ।भुजङ्गयक्षगन्धर्वप्रबुद्धकमलोत्पलम् ।। 5.57.3 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vātasaṅghātajātormicandrāṁśuśiśirāmbumat ।bhujaṅgayakṣagandharvaprabuddhakamalotpalam ।। 5.57.3 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman leaped ike the Windgod, unwearied across the sky, as a huge boat crosses an ocean. The ocean was graced with a swan, the sky with constellation of Swati with fullblown lotuses and water lilies, like the nagas, yakshas, and gandharvas gathered together. The Moon in the sky was like a white lotus, the Sun like a waterfowl, the auspicious Tishya and Shravana like the sweetvoiced swans, and the clouds like duckweeds and green grassy spots on the shore. The Punarvasu star was like a large fish and the planet Mars was like a crocodile. Airavata was like the great island. The waves produced by the wind were like cool moonlight in the cold water.

verses.sloka: हनुमान् मारुतगतिर्महानौरिव सागरम् ।अपारमपरिश्रान्तः पुप्लुवे गगनार्णवम् ।। 5.57.4 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hanumān mārutagatirmahānauriva sāgaram ।apāramapariśrāntaḥ pupluve gaganārṇavam ।। 5.57.4 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman leaped ike the Windgod, unwearied across the sky, as a huge boat crosses an ocean. The ocean was graced with a swan, the sky with constellation of Swati with fullblown lotuses and water lilies, like the nagas, yakshas, and gandharvas gathered together. The Moon in the sky was like a white lotus, the Sun like a waterfowl, the auspicious Tishya and Shravana like the sweetvoiced swans, and the clouds like duckweeds and green grassy spots on the shore. The Punarvasu star was like a large fish and the planet Mars was like a crocodile. Airavata was like the great island. The waves produced by the wind were like cool moonlight in the cold water.
translations.hindi: ये सब, सिद्धपुरुषों से भली माति प्रथंसित, ्रात्मज्ञ, महावेगवान्‌ भ्रौर महाबलवान पवननन्दन ही की भोर टकटकी लगाए चले जाते थे । मानो वे हनुमानजी की दृष्टि के बल उड़ाए लिए जाते थे

verses.sloka: ग्रसमान इवाकाशं ताराधिपमिवोल्लिखन् ।हरन्निव सनक्षत्रं गगनं सार्कमण्डलम् ।। 5.57.5 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: grasamāna ivākāśaṁ tārādhipamivollikhan ।haranniva sanakṣatraṁ gaganaṁ sārkamaṇḍalam ।। 5.57.5 ।।।।

translations.english: Great Hanuman, son of the Windgod, flew through the abode of the Windgod as if he was swallowing the space, scratching the Moon, lord of the stars, as if seizing the heavens along with the constellation of Sun and stars and as though he was drawing the clusters of clouds.
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे--“महेनद्राग्रं ।” २ समाज्यमानं-सम्पूज्यमानं । (गो०) ३ भतः--सिद्धट्िः । (रा०) ४ भर्थेनिव्‌ त्ति--भ्रथंसिद्धि । (गो०) ५ समुद्वार्थाः--सिद्धकार्याः । (गो०) ६ कर्मसिद्विमिः-कायंसिद्धिभिः (गो०) ७ उन्नताः-इतरेम्य उत्कृष्टाः । (यो०) ५२८ सुन्दरकाण्डे उन्होंने म करसि धीरी का कायं पूरा करके प्रब सफलमनोरथ हो चुके हें श्रौर इससे उनको यश प्राप्त हो चुका है । प्रत: कार्य पूरा करने के कारण, वे कपि पपने को श्रन्य वानरों से उत्कृष्ट समझ रहे थे

verses.sloka: मारुतस्यात्मजः श्रीमान् कपिर्व्योमचरो महान् ।हनुमान् मेघजालानि विकर्षन्निव गच्छति ।। 5.57.6 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mārutasyātmajaḥ śrīmān kapirvyomacaro mahān ।hanumān meghajālāni vikarṣanniva gacchati ।। 5.57.6 ।।।।

translations.english: Great Hanuman, son of the Windgod, flew through the abode of the Windgod as if he was swallowing the space, scratching the Moon, lord of the stars, as if seizing the heavens along with the constellation of Sun and stars and as though he was drawing the clusters of clouds.
translations.hindi: सभी वानर श्रीरामचन्द्रजी को यह सुख संवाद सुनाने को उत्सुक हो रहे थे, सब लोग युद्ध का अभिनन्दन करने को तत्यर थे । वे मनस्वी वानर (रावण से) श्रीरामचन्द्रजी का वदला लेने का दृढ़ संकल्प किए हुए थे

verses.sloka: पाण्डरारुणवर्णानि नीलमाञ्जिष्ठकानि च ।हरितारुणवर्णानि महाभ्राणि चकाशिरे ।। 5.57.7 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pāṇḍarāruṇavarṇāni nīlamāñjiṣṭhakāni ca ।haritāruṇavarṇāni mahābhrāṇi cakāśire ।। 5.57.7 ।।।।

translations.english: (In contact with Hanuman) the clouds shone forth brilliantly in white and black, in blue and yellow and in greenish red colour.

verses.sloka: प्रविशन्नभ्रजालानि निष्पतंश्च पुनः पुनः ।प्रच्छन्नश्च प्रकाशश्च चन्द्रमा इव लक्ष्यते ।। 5.57.8 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: praviśannabhrajālāni niṣpataṁśca punaḥ punaḥ ।pracchannaśca prakāśaśca candramā iva lakṣyate ।। 5.57.8 ।।।।

translations.english: With his exist and entrances into the mass of clouds, his appearances and disappearances among the clouds, he looked like the Moon.

verses.sloka: विविधाभ्रघनापन्नगोचरो धवलाम्बरः ।दृश्यादृश्यतनुर्वीरस्तदा चन्द्रायते ऽम्बरे ।। 5.57.9 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vividhābhraghanāpannagocaro dhavalāmbaraḥ ।dṛśyādṛśyatanurvīrastadā candrāyate 'mbare ।। 5.57.9 ।।।।

translations.english: Passing through the clouds, appearing and disappearing, the heroic Hanuman clad in white was like the Moon in the white sky.

verses.sloka: तार्क्ष्यायमाणो गगने बभासे वायुनन्दनः ।दारयन् मेघवृन्दानि निष्पतंश्च पुनः पुनः ।। 5.57.10 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tārkṣyāyamāṇo gagane babhāse vāyunandanaḥ ।dārayan meghavṛndāni niṣpataṁśca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 5.57.10 ।।।।

translations.english: As he made his way through flakes of clouds, again and again appearing and disappearing, Hanuman the delight of the Windgod shone in the sky roaring like a thundering cloud. He looked like Garuda.
translations.hindi: उस उपवन की रखवाली महाबली दधिमुख नामक वानर सदा किया करता था । वह दधिमुख, महात्मा वानरराज सुग्रीव का मामा था ॥&॥ ते तद्वनसुपागम्य बभूवुः परमोत्कटाः१ । वानरा वानरेन्द्रस्य मन:कान्ततमं महत्‌

verses.sloka: नदन्नादेन महता मेघस्वनमहास्वनः ।प्रवरान् राक्षसान् हत्वा नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः ।। 5.57.11 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nadannādena mahatā meghasvanamahāsvanaḥ ।pravarān rākṣasān hatvā nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ ।। 5.57.11 ।।।।

translations.english: The glorious Hanuman, having killed eminent ogres and thereby making himself widely known, having caused havoc to the city of Lanka and terrific sorrow to Ravana by tormenting the army, offered salutations to Vaidehi from midocean and continued his journey.

verses.sloka: आकुलां नगरीं कृत्वा व्यथयित्वा च रावणम् ।अर्दयित्वा बलं घोरं वैदेहीमभिवाद्य च ।। 5.57.12 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ākulāṁ nagarīṁ kṛtvā vyathayitvā ca rāvaṇam ।ardayitvā balaṁ ghoraṁ vaidehīmabhivādya ca ।। 5.57.12 ।।।।

translations.english: The glorious Hanuman, having killed eminent ogres and thereby making himself widely known, having caused havoc to the city of Lanka and terrific sorrow to Ravana by tormenting the army, offered salutations to Vaidehi from midocean and continued his journey.

verses.sloka: आजगाम महातेजाः पुनर्मध्येन सागरम् ।। 5.57.13 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ājagāma mahātejāḥ punarmadhyena sāgaram ।। 5.57.13 ।।।।

translations.english: The valiant Hanuman touched the lord of mountains fondly and went with great speed just as an arrow released from the centre of a powerful bowstring.
translations.hindi: भाज्ञा पाते ही सब वानर भ्रत्यन्त हृषित हो गए श्रौर मुदित हो मघुवन में जा कर, इघर-उघर नाचने-कूदने लगे

verses.sloka: पर्वतेन्द्रं सुनाभं च समुपस्पृश्य वीर्यवान् ।ज्यामुक्त इव नाराचो महावेगो ऽभ्युपागतः ।। 5.57.14 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: parvatendraṁ sunābhaṁ ca samupaspṛśya vīryavān ।jyāmukta iva nārāco mahāvego 'bhyupāgataḥ ।। 5.57.14 ।।।।

translations.english: The chief of the monkeys arrived near, and beholding the face of the Mahendra mountain, which resembled a mass of clouds, thundered.
translations.hindi: उस समय उन वानरों में से कोई-कोई तो गाना गा रहे थे, कोई-कोई भ्रापस में प्रणाम कर रहे थे । कोई-कोई नाच रहे थे, कोई-कोई बड़ी जोर से हँस रहे थे, कोई-कोई गिर-गिर पड़ते थे, कोई-कोई मधुवन में इघर-उघर घूम-फिर रहे थे, कोई-कोई उछल-कद रहे थे प्रौर कोई-कोई व्यर्थं की वकबाद कर रहे थे

verses.sloka: स किंचिदनुसंप्राप्तः समालोक्य महागिरिम् ।महेन्द्रमेघसङ्काशं ननाद हरिपुङ्गवः ।। 5.57.15 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa kiṁcidanusaṁprāptaḥ samālokya mahāgirim ।mahendrameghasaṅkāśaṁ nanāda haripuṅgavaḥ ।। 5.57.15 ।।।।

translations.english: The thundering noise of Hanuman filled all the ten directions with great sound.
translations.hindi: निसग- विसर्जन । (गो०) ५३० सुन्दरकाण्डे कोई-कोई झापस में लिपट रहे थे, कोई-कोई झापस म॑ भिड़ रहे थे, किसी किसी में भ्रापस में कहासुनी हो रही थी प्रौर कोई-कोई आराम कर रहे थे

verses.sloka: स पूरयामास कपिर्दिशो दश समन्ततः ।नदन्नादेन महता मेघस्वनमहास्वनः ।। 5.57.16 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa pūrayāmāsa kapirdiśo daśa samantataḥ ।nadannādena mahatā meghasvanamahāsvanaḥ ।। 5.57.16 ।।।।

translations.english: Having sighted the place of his companions and waiting to see them for long that tiger among monkeys made a loud noise and shook his tail in joy.
translations.hindi: कोई-कोई वृक्षों ही वृक्षों पर दोडते फिरते थे, कोई-कोई पेड़ पर चढ़ कर जमीन पर कृदते थे भ्रौर कोई-कोई पृथिवी से उछल कर, बड़ी तेजी से बड़े ऊँचे-ऊँचे वृक्षों की फुनगी पर चढ़ जाते थे

verses.sloka: स तं देशमनुप्राप्तः सुहृद्दर्शनलालसः ।ननाद हरिशाद्रूलो लाङ्गूलं चाप्यकम्पयत् ।। 5.57.17 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa taṁ deśamanuprāptaḥ suhṛddarśanalālasaḥ ।nanāda hariśādrūlo lāṅgūlaṁ cāpyakampayat ।। 5.57.17 ।।।।

translations.english: By the terrific sounds made by Hanuman in joy, it seemed as though the pathway of Garuda, the sky along with the Sun's orbit was splitting.
translations.hindi: उनमें से कोई गाता था तो कोई हसता हुआ उसके पास पहुंचता था । कोई हसता था तो दूसरा रोता हुआ उसके पास जाता था । एक रोता था तो दूसरा उसके रोने की नकल करता हुम्रा उसके पास जाता था । जब एक चिल्लाता था, तब दूसरा उससे भी भ्रधिक चिल्लाता हुझ्ा उसके पास जाता था

verses.sloka: तस्य नानद्यमानस्य सुपर्णचरिते पथि ।फलतीवास्य घोषेण गगनं सार्कमण्डलम् ।। 5.57.18 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya nānadyamānasya suparṇacarite pathi ।phalatīvāsya ghoṣeṇa gaganaṁ sārkamaṇḍalam ।। 5.57.18 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter the brave and powerful monkeys waiting on the northern shore of the ocean for the arrival of the son of the Windgod, heard the roar and thundering sound of the stormy cloud produced by the sweeping motion of Hanuman's thighs propelled by the speed of his movement.
translations.hindi: उस कपिवाहिनी में उस समय इस प्रकार तुमुल शब्द हो रहा था । उस सेना में ऐसा कोई वानर न था जिसने पेट भर उत्सुकतापूर्वक मधु न पिया एकषष्टितमः सगं: ५३१ हो म्रौर जो मदीति कर मतवाला न हो गथा और न कोई ऐसा ही था जो भषुपान करके तृप्त न न हुआ हो

verses.sloka: ये तु तत्रोत्तरे तीरे समुद्रस्य महाबलाः ।पूर्वं संविष्ठिताः शूरा वायुपुत्रदिदृक्षवः ।। 5.57.19 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ye tu tatrottare tīre samudrasya mahābalāḥ ।pūrvaṁ saṁviṣṭhitāḥ śūrā vāyuputradidṛkṣavaḥ ।। 5.57.19 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter the brave and powerful monkeys waiting on the northern shore of the ocean for the arrival of the son of the Windgod, heard the roar and thundering sound of the stormy cloud produced by the sweeping motion of Hanuman's thighs propelled by the speed of his movement.

verses.sloka: महतो वायुनुन्नस्य तोयदस्येव गर्जितम् ।शुश्रुवुस्ते तदा घोषमूरुवेगं हनूमतः ।। 5.57.20 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mahato vāyununnasya toyadasyeva garjitam ।śuśruvuste tadā ghoṣamūruvegaṁ hanūmataḥ ।। 5.57.20 ।।।।

translations.english: All the vanaras who were feeling dejected and waiting anxiously heard the noise of Hanuman that sounded like a thundering cloud.
translations.hindi: किन्तु वे वानर भला कब मानने वाले थे । उन्होंने उस बूढ़े दधिमुख ही «को डाँटा-डपटा ॥ तब तो वह तेजस्वी वानर भी उन वानरों से वन को बचान के लिए उपाय करने लगा

verses.sloka: ते दीनमनसः सर्वे शुश्रुवुः काननौकसः ।वानरेन्द्रस्य निर्घोषं पर्जन्यनिनदोपमम् ।। 5.57.21 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te dīnamanasaḥ sarve śuśruvuḥ kānanaukasaḥ ।vānarendrasya nirghoṣaṁ parjanyaninadopamam ।। 5.57.21 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing the loud voice of Hanuman, all the vanaras were longing to see their friend.

verses.sloka: निशम्य नदतो नादं वानरास्ते समन्ततः ।बभूवुरुत्सुकाः सर्वे सुहृद्दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः ।। 5.57.22 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: niśamya nadato nādaṁ vānarāste samantataḥ ।babhūvurutsukāḥ sarve suhṛddarśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।। 5.57.22 ।।।।

translations.english: Jambavan the chief of vanaras became very happy at heart and called all the vanaras and spoke:
translations.hindi: कारण भला वे क्या किसी के रोके कमें कारण, भय तो किसी इकट्ठे हो दधिमुख किन्तु नशे में चूर होने के क वाले थे । इन वानरों को सीता का संवाद लाने फे का था ही नहीं, सो ये पपने झपराध पर घ्रान न दे झौर को पकड़ कर खींचने लगे

verses.sloka: जाम्बवान् स हरिश्रेष्ठः प्रीतिसंहृष्टमानसः ।उपामन्त्र्य हरीन् सर्वानिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। 5.57.23 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: jāmbavān sa hariśreṣṭhaḥ prītisaṁhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।upāmantrya harīn sarvānidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 5.57.23 ।।।।

translations.english: "Oh Hanuman is always successful. If he has not, he would not make sounds in this manner".
translations.hindi: इति एकषष्टितमः सगं: ॥। साथ ही मतवालेपन से वे उसे नखों से खसोटते, दांतों से काटते, थप्पड़ जमाते शरीर लाते मारते थे । अन्त में मारते-मारते दधिमुख को उन लोगों ने मृतप्राय कर मूछित कर दिया और उस विशाल मधुवन को तो विल्कुल चौपट ही कर डाला

verses.sloka: सर्वथा कृतकार्यो ऽसौ हनूमान्नात्र संशयः ।न ह्यस्याकृतकार्यस्य नाद एवंविधो भवेत् ।। 5.57.24 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sarvathā kṛtakāryo 'sau hanūmānnātra saṁśayaḥ ।na hyasyākṛtakāryasya nāda evaṁvidho bhavet ।। 5.57.24 ।।।।

translations.english: Hearing the sound of his dashing movements of arms and thighs the vanaras jumped about in joy, then and there.

verses.sloka: तस्य बाहूरुवेगं च निनादं च महात्मनः ।निशम्य हरयो हृष्टाः समुत्पेतुस्ततस्ततः ।। 5.57.25 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya bāhūruvegaṁ ca ninādaṁ ca mahātmanaḥ ।niśamya harayo hṛṣṭāḥ samutpetustatastataḥ ।। 5.57.25 ।।।।

translations.english: The vanaras were very happy. Longing to see Hanuman, they jumped from one tree top to another and from one peak of a mountain to the other.

verses.sloka: ते नगाग्रान्नगाग्राणि शिखराच्छिखराणि च ।प्रहृष्टाः समपद्यन्त हनूमन्तं दिदृक्षवः ।। 5.57.26 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te nagāgrānnagāgrāṇi śikharācchikharāṇi ca ।prahṛṣṭāḥ samapadyanta hanūmantaṁ didṛkṣavaḥ ।। 5.57.26 ।।।।

translations.english: Waiting for Hanuman, the vanaras jumped from the tree tops holding the branches. They shook the branches just like clothes to welcome friends.

verses.sloka: ते प्रीताः पादपाग्रेषु गृह्य शाखाः सुविष्ठिताः ।वासांसीव प्रशाखाश्च समाविध्यन्त वानराः ।। 5.57.27 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te prītāḥ pādapāgreṣu gṛhya śākhāḥ suviṣṭhitāḥ ।vāsāṁsīva praśākhāśca samāvidhyanta vānarāḥ ।। 5.57.27 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the powerful son of the Windgod roared like the wind captured in a mountain cave would.

verses.sloka: गिरिगह्वरसंलीनो यथा गर्जति मारुतः ।एवं जगर्ज बलवान् हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः ।। 5.57.28 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: girigahvarasaṁlīno yathā garjati mārutaḥ ।evaṁ jagarja balavān hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ ।। 5.57.28 ।।।।

translations.english: (On seeing) Hanuman, who was resembling a heavy cloud approaching, the vanaras stood with folded hands.

verses.sloka: तमभ्रघनसङ्काशमापतन्तं महाकपिम् ।दृष्ट्वा ते वानराः सर्वे तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयस्तदा ।। 5.57.29 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamabhraghanasaṅkāśamāpatantaṁ mahākapim ।dṛṣṭvā te vānarāḥ sarve tasthuḥ prāñjalayastadā ।। 5.57.29 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter the vanara, who resembled a mountain, descended with great speed on the summit of mount Mahendra full of trees.

verses.sloka: ततस्तु वेगवांस्तस्य गिरेर्गिरिनिभः कपिः ।निपपात महेन्द्रस्य शिखरे पादपाकुले ।। 5.57.30 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu vegavāṁstasya girergirinibhaḥ kapiḥ ।nipapāta mahendrasya śikhare pādapākule ।। 5.57.30 ।।।।

translations.english: Overwhelmed with immeasurable joy, Hanuman descended from the sky like the mountain with its wings cut off and dropped on the bank of a mountain stream.

verses.sloka: हर्षेणापूर्यमाणो ऽसौ रम्ये पर्वतनिर्झरे ।छिन्नपक्ष इवाकाशात् पपात धरणीधरः ।। 5.57.31 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: harṣeṇāpūryamāṇo 'sau ramye parvatanirjhare ।chinnapakṣa ivākāśāt papāta dharaṇīdharaḥ ।। 5.57.31 ।।।।

translations.english: Feeling very happy at heart all the vanara leaders gathered around Hanuman. They stood motionless with extreme happiness.

verses.sloka: ततस्ते प्रीतमनसः सर्वे वानरपुङ्गवाः ।हनूमन्तं महात्मानं परिवार्योपतस्थिरे ।परिवार्य च ते सर्वे परां प्रीतिमुपागताः ।। 5.57.32 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataste prītamanasaḥ sarve vānarapuṅgavāḥ ।hanūmantaṁ mahātmānaṁ parivāryopatasthire ।parivārya ca te sarve parāṁ prītimupāgatāḥ ।। 5.57.32 ।।।।

translations.english: Feeling very happy at heart all the vanara leaders gathered around Hanuman. They stood motionless with extreme happiness.

verses.sloka: प्रहृष्टवदनाः सर्वे तमरोगमुपागतम् ।उपायनानि चादाय मूलानि च फलानि च ।प्रत्यर्चयन् हरिश्रेष्ठं हरयो मारुतात्मजम् ।। 5.57.33 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: prahṛṣṭavadanāḥ sarve tamarogamupāgatam ।upāyanāni cādāya mūlāni ca phalāni ca ।pratyarcayan hariśreṣṭhaṁ harayo mārutātmajam ।। 5.57.33 ।।।।

translations.english: The vanaras were filled with joy seeing Hanuman who returned unhurt. They offered roots and fruits to him. Hanuman on his part offered salutations to the foremost of the monkeys.

verses.sloka: हनुमांस्तु गुरून् वृद्धान् जाम्बवत्प्रमुखांस्तदा ।कुमारमङ्गदं चैव सो ऽवन्दत महाकपिः ।। 5.57.34 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hanumāṁstu gurūn vṛddhān jāmbavatpramukhāṁstadā ।kumāramaṅgadaṁ caiva so 'vandata mahākapiḥ ।। 5.57.34 ।।।।

translations.english: The great Hanuman also offered salutations to elders, preceptors such as Jambavan and other leaders. He also saluted the young Angada.

verses.sloka: स ताभ्यां पूजितः पूज्यः कपिभिश्च प्रसादितः ।दृष्टा सीतेति विक्रान्तः संक्षेपेण न्यवेदयत् ।। 5.57.35 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tābhyāṁ pūjitaḥ pūjyaḥ kapibhiśca prasāditaḥ ।dṛṣṭā sīteti vikrāntaḥ saṁkṣepeṇa nyavedayat ।। 5.57.35 ।।।।

translations.english: The valiant Hanuman worthy of worship having been honoured by both Jambavan and Angada was pleased. He responded briefly, saying 'Saw Sita'.

verses.sloka: निषसाद च हस्तेन गृहीत्वा वालिनः सुतम् ।रमणीये वनोद्देशे महेन्द्रस्य गिरेस्तदा ।। 5.57.36 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: niṣasāda ca hastena gṛhītvā vālinaḥ sutam ।ramaṇīye vanoddeśe mahendrasya girestadā ।। 5.57.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Then holding the hand of Vali's son he sat down at a beautiful location of the garden of mountain Mahendra.

verses.sloka: हनुमानब्रवीद्धृष्टस्तदा तान् वानरर्षभान् ।। 5.57.37 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hanumānabravīddhṛṣṭastadā tān vānararṣabhān ।। 5.57.37 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman felt happy and told Angada, the bull of vanaras, "I saw Sita in the groves of Ashoka guarded by dreadful ogres. She is blameless, eager to see Rama. She is wearing a single braid of hair. She is young and emaciated due to fasting. Her hair is matted and soiled".

verses.sloka: अशोकवनिकासंस्था दृष्टा सा जनकात्मजा ।रक्ष्यमाणा सुघोराभी राक्षसीभिरनिन्दिता ।। 5.57.38 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: aśokavanikāsaṁsthā dṛṣṭā sā janakātmajā ।rakṣyamāṇā sughorābhī rākṣasībhiraninditā ।। 5.57.38 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman felt happy and told Angada, the bull of vanaras, "I saw Sita in the groves of Ashoka guarded by dreadful ogres. She is blameless, eager to see Rama. She is wearing a single braid of hair. She is young and emaciated due to fasting. Her hair is matted and soiled".

verses.sloka: एकवेणीधरा बाला रामदर्शनलालसा ।उपवासपरिश्रान्ता जटिला मलिना कृशा ।। 5.57.39 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ekaveṇīdharā bālā rāmadarśanalālasā ।upavāsapariśrāntā jaṭilā malinā kṛśā ।। 5.57.39 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman felt happy and told Angada, the bull of vanaras, "I saw Sita in the groves of Ashoka guarded by dreadful ogres. She is blameless, eager to see Rama. She is wearing a single braid of hair. She is young and emaciated due to fasting. Her hair is matted and soiled".

verses.sloka: ततो दृष्टेति वचनं महार्थममृतोपमम् ।निशम्य मारुतेः सर्वे मुदिता वानरा भवन् ।। 5.57.40 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato dṛṣṭeti vacanaṁ mahārthamamṛtopamam ।niśamya māruteḥ sarve muditā vānarā bhavan ।। 5.57.40 ।।।।

translations.english: Then hearing Hanuman's meaningful and nectarlike words all the vanaras rejoiced.

verses.sloka: क्ष्वेलन्त्यन्ये नदन्त्यन्ये गर्जन्त्यन्ये महाबलाः ।चक्रुः किलिकिलामन्ये प्रतिगर्जन्ति चापरे ।। 5.57.41 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kṣvelantyanye nadantyanye garjantyanye mahābalāḥ ।cakruḥ kilikilāmanye pratigarjanti cāpare ।। 5.57.41 ।।।।

translations.english: Some powerful vanaras howled, some chattered, some roared and some screamed, going round and round and others echoed the sounds.

verses.sloka: केचिदुच्छ्रितलाङ्गूलाः प्रहृष्टाः कपिकुञ्जराः ।अञ्चिता यतदीर्घाणि लांगूलानि प्रविव्यधुः ।। 5.57.42 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: keciducchritalāṅgūlāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ kapikuñjarāḥ ।añcitā yatadīrghāṇi lāṁgūlāni pravivyadhuḥ ।। 5.57.42 ।।।।

translations.english: Some elephantlike vanaras who were excited and felt overjoyed lifted their long and beautiful tails and hit them on the ground.

verses.sloka: अपरे च हनूमन्तं वानरा वारणोपमम् ।आप्लुत्य गिरिशृङ्गेभ्यः संस्पृशन्ति स्म हर्षिताः ।। 5.57.43 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: apare ca hanūmantaṁ vānarā vāraṇopamam ।āplutya giriśṛṅgebhyaḥ saṁspṛśanti sma harṣitāḥ ।। 5.57.43 ।।।।

translations.english: A few vanaras jumped down from the mountain top and hugged the elephantlike Hanuman.

verses.sloka: उक्तवाक्यं हनूमन्तमङ्गदस्तमथाब्रवीत् ।सर्वेषां हरिवीराणां मध्ये वचनमुत्तमम् ।। 5.57.44 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: uktavākyaṁ hanūmantamaṅgadastamathābravīt ।sarveṣāṁ harivīrāṇāṁ madhye vacanamuttamam ।। 5.57.44 ।।।।

translations.english: And hearing Hanuman's sweetest words, Angada addressed the heroic vanaras

verses.sloka: सत्त्वे वीर्ये न ते कश्चित् समो वानर विद्यते ।यदवप्लुत्य विस्तीर्णं सागरं पुनरागतः ।। 5.57.45 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sattve vīrye na te kaścit samo vānara vidyate ।yadavaplutya vistīrṇaṁ sāgaraṁ punarāgataḥ ।। 5.57.45 ।।।।

translations.english: "O vanara you have leaped such a wide ocean and have returned. In strength and valour. There is none equal to you.

verses.sloka: अहो स्वामिनि ते भक्तिरहो वीर्यमहो धृतिः ।दिष्ट्या दृष्टा त्वया देवी रामपत्नी यशस्विनी ।। 5.57.46 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: aho svāmini te bhaktiraho vīryamaho dhṛtiḥ ।diṣṭyā dṛṣṭā tvayā devī rāmapatnī yaśasvinī ।। 5.57.46 ।।।।

translations.english: "O your devotion to the king, O your valour, fortitude and courage is admirable. You could see Rama's wife, an illustrious lady. This is a matter of our good luck. Rama will (now) shed the sorrow due to separation from Sita.

verses.sloka: दिष्ट्या त्यक्ष्यति काकुत्स्थः शोकं सीतावियोगजम् ।ततो ऽङ्गदं हनूमन्तं जाम्बवन्तं च वानराः ।। 5.57.47 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: diṣṭyā tyakṣyati kākutsthaḥ śokaṁ sītāviyogajam ।tato 'ṅgadaṁ hanūmantaṁ jāmbavantaṁ ca vānarāḥ ।। 5.57.47 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the vanaras went round all the three Angada, Hanuman and Jambavan. Out of joy they lay down on the huge rocks.

verses.sloka: परिवार्य प्रमुदिता भेजिरे विपुलाः शिलाः ।श्रोतुकामाः समुद्रस्य लङ्घनं वानरोत्तमाः ।। 5.57.48 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: parivārya pramuditā bhejire vipulāḥ śilāḥ ।śrotukāmāḥ samudrasya laṅghanaṁ vānarottamāḥ ।। 5.57.48 ।।।।

translations.english: All the vanaras longing to listen to Hanuman about his crossing the ocean, seeing Lanka, Sita and Ravana kept looking at the face of Hanuman.

verses.sloka: दर्शनं चापि लङ्कायाः सीताया रावणस्य च ।तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे हनुमद्वदनोन्मुखाः ।। 5.57.49 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: darśanaṁ cāpi laṅkāyāḥ sītāyā rāvaṇasya ca ।tasthuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve hanumadvadanonmukhāḥ ।। 5.57.49 ।।।।

translations.english: All the vanaras longing to listen to Hanuman about his crossing the ocean, seeing Lanka, Sita and Ravana kept looking at the face of Hanuman.

verses.sloka: तस्थौ तत्राङ्गदः श्रीमान् वानरैर्बहुभिर्वृतः ।उपास्यमानो विबुधैर्दिवि देवपतिर्यथा ।। 5.57.50 ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasthau tatrāṅgadaḥ śrīmān vānarairbahubhirvṛtaḥ ।upāsyamāno vibudhairdivi devapatiryathā ।। 5.57.50 ।।।।

translations.english: Surrounded by many great vanaras, Angada was shining like Indra, lord of the gods attended by the gods in heaven.

verses.sloka: हनूमता कीर्तिमता यशस्विना तथा ऽङ्गदेनाङ्गदबद्धबाहुना ।मुदा तदाध्यासितमुन्नतं महन्महीधराग्रं ज्वलितं श्रिया ऽभवत् ।। 5.57.51 ।।
verses.transliteration: hanūmatā kīrtimatā yaśasvinā tathā 'ṅgadenāṅgadabaddhabāhunā ।mudā tadādhyāsitamunnataṁ mahanmahīdharāgraṁ jvalitaṁ śriyā 'bhavat ।। 5.57.51 ।।

translations.english: The mountain peak graced by famous Hanuman and renowned Angada bedecked with armlets seated on top joyfully, appeared prosperous and splendid. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyseventh sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
